sources.license: No licence file in the pinned tree, and its README states no reuse terms. Derived-only custody under the known-best retention policy: no upstream byte is retained, every file is bound here by SHA-256 and at the pin by its Git blob, and no redistribution permission or licence determination is asserted. The issue leaves credit for packings started from the literature with their discoverers and discloses Gemini 3.8 assistance with solver scripting, precision checks and formatting.
claims: Issue #470, resubmitted with errata on 2026-10-09, reports s(n) <= S_n at 28 counts, S_n the side printed in certificates/square-<n>.txt rounded up at 12 decimals, each a decimal centre-angle pose at 16 digits (36 digits for 199 and 263) in a box centred at the origin. At n = 88 the issue says S_n ties SQUISH's 12-decimal display.
s(132) <= 11.986956226066, from a printed side of 11.986956226065860420249009621329605579: in the release's README and certificates/ since 06b484b, not named in the issue.
s(267) <= 16.838828608296, from a printed side of 16.838828608295706601438723737373948097: in the release's README and certificates/ since 06b484b, not named in the issue.

certificates/ also holds 18 poses at n = 343 to 360, added in 2b76e6f and called records in the README; every printed side is at least 19.000000000004, above the grid bound s(n) <= 19 that holds for every n <= 361.

The issue reports that David Ellsworth's check_packing.py at precision 40 and epsilon 1e-14, and an independent 60-digit separating-axis check, accept all 28, and that shrinking the container by 1e-9 or moving a square 1e-6 is refused. These are author reports. squarepacker found overlaps in the 4e1a601 square-199 and square-263; the author re-quenched both in dd3da5c.

The issue pins dd3da5c7b39f3796d19e0970bc2350ef9ea14ad, which has 39 hex digits and names no commit. The corrected certificates are at dd3da5c753c5ded6cb3b89476193b7b801005415, which shares its first eight digits, is the repository head, and is the only commit after 4e1a601 to change square-199.txt and square-263.txt; its 28 certificate files have the SHA-256 digests the issue lists.
